svg.title: TOPAK A3 — Fourteen boundaries on one picture: the boundary register mapped
svg.desc: Every boundary the 2026.09.13 register names, placed on the system it divides and tagged with its id. The register is dated: it was written against the 09.12 checkpoint, nothing in it is a ratified decision, and rows marked † are analysis with no record behind them. Where a later record has since changed a boundary, the change is stated as G7 and ToO rev 11 have it, in the last column of the register below.
svg.text: TOPAK · A3

text.tspan: Fourteen boundaries on one picture: the boundary register mapped

svg.text: Every boundary the 2026.09.13 register names, placed on the system it divides and tagged with its id. The register is dated: it was written against the 09.12 checkpoint, nothing in it is a ratified decision, and rows marked † are analysis with no record behind them. Where a later record has since changed a boundary, the change is stated as G7 and ToO rev 11 have it, in the last column of the register below.

At archetype custody removable only with their own consent, so at the gate: attributable non-principals, Mediated as attribution only (ADR-0002 A2, ToO §7.5). At degenerate
custody they become principals and the gate moves to the eviction or recovery rule.
Issue and Resign are environment events no principal can express. Intent is the sole axiom (ADR-0025): no theorem covers it.

text.tspan: B14 · Gate approver: outside every theorem

svg.text: Build: constitutive (HITL). Promotion needs every counted grant seat; grant-seat humans are principals, evictable by the anchor (ADR-0024, ToO §7.5). If they never show up, Build stalls.
Run: supervisory (HOTL). The window W is about a second; no human fits inside it. If the human never shows up, Run proceeds: HOTL is disabling only.
HOOTL: absent. The interval D was named and unbudgeted (†); ADR-0032 gives it a form, W + L + D < T_irrev, with L unmeasured.
One principal holds exactly one seat; the agent is a cell of them (ADR-0037).
The Thinker holds a Persona: model, prompt, decoding, decoder, seat, pinned (ADR-0016).
Principal type: Contained or Mediated; rung 0 is Mediated, always.

text.tspan: Verified object: what is proved once, with the mechanism

svg.text: The admit path: epoch fence → lease → syntactic lift → floor → bundle →
consensus-ordered admit (ToO §15).
The mechanism release, its floor text, schema S and engine, pinned by digest.
Actions under a fenced epoch are rejected by mechanism, not policy: the
cheapest check.
Cedar, linked into the mechanism, resident (ADR-0012, ADR-0030). The genesis
text is DRAFT.
R1, R2, R5, R6, R7, R9 bound every anchor issuance (ADR-0026).
Break-glass and erasure, plus the six forensic classes, as floor entries.
OPA/Rego, signed (ADR-0044), versioned; may subtract, never add. Change at incident cadence.
Promoted parameters; the decoder ships in the Persona, the validator in the mechanism (ADR-0018).
Per-axis declarations under ADR-0023: degenerate forms lose theorems, never gain capability.
refinements only:
subtraction
Contain is one component, instantiated twice: both membranes run this mechanism
Admits, denials, votes, issuances, heartbeats: actions, identities, ordering.
The archive keeps a hash and a pointer for each payload (ADR-0004).
Prompt text, commentary, raw emission: in a separately governed store built for deletion.
facts cross; payloads do not

text.tspan: Round topics: one per principal per round

svg.text: Sealed on emit completion (Build: at Submit); the topic is the unit of erasure (ADR-0003).
Erasure deletes sealed topics; crypto-shredding was rejected (ToO §4.3).
Admits, stop attribution, votes, issuances, break-glass, erasure events (ADR-0028, C1).
Stack vocabulary from Moon & Varshney Figure 1 (register §10.1)
Effect exclusivity is assumed, not enforced (register §10.1). ADR-0034 now designs the discharge: rungs 0–3 and profile clauses P1–P7,
attested at lease grant. Not built: every lease is rung 0.

text.tspan: B12 · Deployment stack: sandbox and below
dated: written against the 09.12 checkpoint; nothing in it is ratified

svg.text: The first five columns are the register's §1 verbatim. † marks a row the register says is analysis with no ADR behind it; red marks the empty or undefined cells. The last column is this diagram's, drawn from G7 and ToO rev 11: what a later record changed at that boundary.

text.tspan: Since the register (state per G7, narrative per ToO rev 11)

svg.text: Release / incident
Promotion: signature over provenance
None claimed; Submit is sole egress
Fail-closed. Pipeline stalls; PC/EC makes this affordable

The single signing key is gone: promotion is a unanimous quorum grant of grant seats, votes bound to (artifact, gate-evidence, rules epoch) (ADR-0024). A promotion also stalls without the author's cell Observer's coverage to the seal (ADR-0024
Release / per-action
None; rejection is synchronous
Fail-closed. Resident default-deny floor, no fetch dependency
The floor is a Cedar library linked into the mechanism: no process, socket or fetch; admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny, any floor error a deny (ADR-0030 §1, §3, C1).
Release (validator) / Persona (decoder)
Validate: total over floor alphabet
None for admissibility; unbounded for
Fail-closed. Parse failure is a local deny, monotone

Raw emission is retained at the archetype so the decoder can be re-run and compared: recovers faithfulness, not intent (ADR-0037 §3; D-0037-2 if not retained). Decoder–alphabet compatibility is still open (G7 item 17).
Release / deploy / incident
Promotion: bundle ⊑ floor
Bundle staleness, unbounded but
Fail-closed and safe while stalled. The model case

The instant moved: bundle ⊑ floor now holds by composition at every admit, for every bundle at every age, and nobody decides it at promotion (ADR-0030 §1). A bundle loads only under an issued key's signature (ADR-0044, C1; built,
Release / per-emission
Fact construction at Observer finding
None claimed
Fail-closed; no payload crosses by default (ADR-0004)
Unchanged in principle. Raw emission joins the payload side, beside the typed action (ADR-0004 B12, ADR-0037); the Reader stage's results cross as facts for the cell Observer (ToO §2.8).
Per-principal, static
Whole lease, for Mediated
N/A: predicate, not a runtime check (09.12 §5)

The lease carries [profile digest, rung] (ADR-0031 §3). Contained has four conjuncts (ADR-0034 §4); the fourth, lineage independence, is ADR-0035, Proposed, so Contained has no members at any rung (G7 §2.3).

text.tspan: B7 Seat LTRO separation of duties

svg.text: Release / Persona
Seat binding in Persona
None claimed
Fail-closed if binding is verified; unstated † (ADR-0016)

Seats are principals: a principal holds exactly one seat, the LTRO is a cell; Thinker and Observer are seats, Listener and Reader are stages (ADR-0037, C3, C4). Alphabets bounded by seat kind in floor text, forbid B10 and a tightened B6,
checked at the grant path first.
Provider (uncontrolled) / Persona
promotion
Undefined. Largest empty cell in the grid (§8)

Persona expiry now has a bound, not a clock: ttl ≤ T_persona at grant and every renewal (ADR-0031 A2; built, ADR-0033 A6), still read on the local clock (G7 item 62). A revoked Persona is a targeted revocation (ToO §6). ToO §10 still calls B8
the most critical boundary.
Deploy / per-round
Seal on emit completion
Between emit and seal
Fail-closed on replay; fail-open on forensics † (ADR-0003,

Forensic floor: six classes non-erasable for the declared horizon (ADR-0028, C1). Crypto-shredding rejected. Topic identity carries the rules-epoch chain (A1) and a denials-only after companion (A2, C1). Genesis issues no erasure roster, so
erasure is disabled from epoch 0.
Constitutive / supervisory / absent
Gate (HITL) or non-refresh (passive e-stop)
D: unbudgeted †
Build: stalls. Run: proceeds: HOTL is disabling only (09.12

The timing property is a budget, W + L + D < T_irrev per effect class (ADR-0032 §4); L is unmeasured and no effect class declares T_irrev. Run effect admits stall on a dead cell Observer, floor entry R3 (ADR-0039, C4).
Release / per-deployment
None claimed
Fail-closed by subtraction; monotone (open: axis question)
The axis question is answered: degeneracy, not a ladder; rungs are per axis and every degeneracy carries a declaration record (ADR-0023, C3). No deployment declaration has been written (G7 §8).
Undefined. Effect exclusivity is assumed, not enforced

The instant now exists: lease grant, the confinement field (ADR-0031 §3). The design exists: attestation rungs 0–3 and profile clauses P1–P7 (ADR-0034, C2, C4); the rung-1 launcher is ADR-0036, Proposed. The mechanism does not: every lease
is rung 0 (G7 item 1, the sandbox gap).
Deploy / per-round
Fence / expiry
≤ TTL for passive stop
Fail-closed. Expiry is a local clock read: but see §9.1 †

§9.1 is discharged: clocks buy liveness, never safety (ADR-0032). Expiry is read locally and then ordered (ADR-0031 E1); the fence is the Paxos log index at grant; revocation is targeted or an epoch fence (ADR-0031, C1).
Undefined. Approver is not evictable, therefore unmodeled

The promotion approver is now a principal (ADR-0024), so what sits at the gate is the anchor's key-holders at archetype custody (ADR-0002 A2, ToO §7.5). Still outside every theorem: anchor intent is the sole axiom, and anchor capture heads the
residual risks (ADR-0025).

text.tspan: §2 · The empty cells are the finding

No instant, no mechanism, permanent interval
Every containment theorem is conditional on an undischarged assumption

HOTL without a response budget reproduces the ignored-warning failure

text.tspan: What the register said to act on, and where it stands

svg.text: B12 and B14 are structural and known; B8 is the one to act on: the only row whose outer side changes at a cadence TOPAK does not control, does not observe by default, and
cannot fence (§2).
Since: B12 has an instant and a design and no mechanism; B8 has a bound, T_persona, on a local clock, and a lineage criterion that is Proposed; B14 is narrowed to the anchor and
stays axiomatic.

The criterion for B2 is evictability, not location: if you can be evicted you are a principal; if you are the authority that evicts you are at the gate. That is exactly why B14 exists (§6).

B7's row names four seats and ADR-0008, both since overtaken: two are seats, two are stages (ADR-0037), and ADR-0008 is superseded by ADR-0038. B6 and B11 to B14 have no companion row in the register.
